source.snippet: I run claude opportunistically looking at positions. It's finding forms of prompt injection on some job postings. Is this a generic thing now?

problem_statement: AI agents scanning job postings on behalf of job seekers or recruiters are encountering adversarial prompt injection embedded in job listings, undermining the reliability of AI-assisted job search and recruitment automation.
target_segment: Technical recruiters, HR-tech builders, and individual developers/operators using LLM agents to screen or apply to job postings at scale.
notes: Poster is paying for Claude API to run job-scanning agents ('I run claude opportunistically'), signaling willingness to pay for tooling. Prompt injection in job postings is an emerging adversarial surface as AI-driven job applications proliferate. Opportunity: a sanitization/detection layer or auditing service for LLM pipelines that process untrusted job board content. Also potential B2B angle for HR-tech platforms wanting to certify their postings as agent-safe. Weak signal (2 comments, 4 points) but technically specific and timely.
